source.label: European Medicines Agency: EU herbal monograph on Ginkgo biloba L., folium (EMA/HMPC/321097/2012, final, 2015)

warnings.verified_quote: If the medicinal product is taken concomitantly with anticoagulants (e.g. phenprocoumon and warfarin) or antiplatelet drugs (e.g. clopidogrel, acetylsalicylic acid and other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs), their effect may be influenced.
also_on_page: 4.4: In patients with a pathologically increased bleeding tendency (haemorrhagic diathesis) and concomitant anticoagulant and antiplatelet treatment, the medicinal product should only be used after consultation with a doctor.
4.5 (traditional use): Ginkgo leaf may increase the effects of anticoagulants such as coumarin derivatives.
warnings.warning_en: The European Medicines Agency says ginkgo leaf may change the effect of antiplatelet medicines such as clopidogrel and aspirin.
warnings.warning_zh: 歐洲藥品管理局話，銀杏葉可能會影響氯吡格雷同阿士匹靈呢類抗血小板藥嘅效果。
warnings.note: The 'only after consultation with a doctor' sentence (4.4) applies only to people with a bleeding tendency on BOTH anticoagulant and antiplatelet treatment, so it is not used in warning_en.
warnings.action_en: Talk to your doctor or pharmacist.
warnings.action_zh: 同醫生或者藥劑師傾吓。

source.label: Health Canada: Ginkgo (Ginkgo biloba) natural health product monograph (25 Jul 2025)

warnings.verified_quote: Ask a health care practitioner/health care provider/health care professional/doctor/physician before use if you are taking diabetes, high blood pressure or seizure medications (Brinker 2010).
also_on_page: Contraindication(s): Do not use if you are taking blood thinners or other health products that affect blood coagulation (Gardner and McGuffin 2013; Brinker 2010; Bent 2005).
warnings.warning_en: Health Canada says to ask a health professional before taking ginkgo if you take medicine for high blood pressure.
warnings.warning_zh: 加拿大衞生部話，如果你食緊降血壓藥，食銀杏之前要先問醫護人員。
warnings.note: Owner to decide whether furosemide counts as 'high blood pressure medication'. The contraindication about blood thinners is stricter than the live ginkgo-warfarin rating (Low · watch); reported to the owner, rating not changed.
warnings.action_en: Talk to your doctor or pharmacist.
warnings.action_zh: 同醫生或者藥劑師傾吓。

source.label: Health Canada: American ginseng (Panax quinquefolius) monograph (30 Jan 2026)

warnings.section: Risk information: Caution(s) and warning(s), All products
warnings.verified_quote: Ask a health care practitioner/health care provider/health care professional/doctor/physician before use if you are taking blood thinners or digoxin (Brinker 2010; Dasgupta et al. 2007; Elmer et al. 2007; Yuan et al. 2004).
warnings.warning_en: Health Canada says to ask a health professional before using American ginseng if you take digoxin.
warnings.warning_zh: 加拿大衞生部話，如果你食緊地高辛，用花旗參之前要先問醫護人員。
warnings.action_en: Talk to your doctor or pharmacist.
warnings.action_zh: 同醫生或者藥劑師傾吓。

source.label: Health Canada: Panax ginseng monograph (27 Jun 2025)

warnings.verified_quote: Ask a health care practitioner/health care provider/health care professional/doctor/physician before use if you are taking antidepressant medication, blood thinners or digoxin (Brinker 2010; Lee et al. 2008a; Dasgupta and Reyes 2005; Janetzki and Morreale 1997; Gonzalez-Seijo et al. 1995; Shader and Greenblatt 1988; Jones and Runikis 1987; Shader and Greenblatt 1985).
warnings.warning_en: Health Canada says to ask a health professional before using Asian ginseng if you take digoxin.

source.label: European Medicines Agency: EU herbal monograph on liquorice root (Glycyrrhizae radix), Revision 1 (EMA/HMPC/108399/2024, final, adopted 4 Mar 2026)

warnings.verified_quote: Liquorice root may counteract antihypertensive action of prescribed medications.
also_on_page: 4.5: Not to be used concomitantly with diuretics, cardiac glycosides, corticosteroids, stimulant laxatives or other medications which may aggravate electrolyte imbalance (see section with 4.4).
warnings.warning_en: The European Medicines Agency says liquorice root may work against blood pressure medicines.
warnings.warning_zh: 歐洲藥品管理局話，甘草根可能會減弱降血壓藥嘅效果。
warnings.note: Replaces the Drugs.com-based round-2 proposal for liquorice + amlodipine, which stays on hold.
warnings.action_en: Talk to your doctor or pharmacist.
warnings.action_zh: 同醫生或者藥劑師傾吓。
